question: In a press conference before the All-Star Game, eight All-Stars will be taking questions. Three are Cubs, three are Red Sox, and two are Yankees. If teammates insist on sitting together, how many ways can the eight All-Stars be seated in a row?
solution:
Treat each team as a single block. The three team blocks can be ordered in 3! ways. Within the blocks, the Cubs can be ordered in 3! ways, the Red Sox in 3! ways, and the Yankees in 2! ways. These choices are independent and determine each valid seating exactly once, so the count is 3! · 3! · 3! · 2! = 6 · 6 · 6 · 2 = 432.
Final answer: 432
